SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro.en: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!
SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro.fr: Même nous, les marins, avons des\nPOKéMON !

SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle.en: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.
SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle.fr: Tous nos POKéMON viennent des\nhautes mers !
